You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Considering the chest X-ray findings, which of the following statements most accurately describes the relationship and characteristics of the ovoid mass in the right paracardiac region as seen in Figure 1a?

A) The mass is inferior to the right heart border and does not affect the adjacent pericardial lining.
B) The mass is superior to the right diaphragm and shows signs of adhesion to the right middle lobe.
C) The mass is located at the level of the right atrium and appears to displace the right heart border laterally.
D) The mass is superior to the right diaphragm and appears to cause partial obliteration of the right heart silhouette.
E) The mass is inferior to the right atrium and shows no evidence of association with the right lung.
F) The mass is anterior to the right atrium and appears to affect the right hemidiaphragm, without significant displacement of the heart.
